title: 5 December 2011: Paul McCartney live at O2 Arena, London
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the O2 Arena in London, England, on 5 December 2011.

It was the 14th show of the On The Run Tour, which lasted for 37 dates between July 2011 and November 2012. This concert was seen by 14,946 fans.

McCartney was joined onstage by The Rolling Stones’ guitarist Ronnie Wood for a rendition of The Beatles’ 1969 hit ‘Get Back’ during the first encore.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), and Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums).

McCartney had previously performed at the O2 Arena on 22 December 2009 for the Good Evening Europe Tour. He returned on 23 and 24 May 2015 for the Out There Tour, and 16 December 2018 for the Freshen Up Tour.
